# bugs #3857: Struct assignments from a conditional expression whose third operand is *f () get wrong bytes

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3857/
- Category: [Fixes](../../fix.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17193
- Recommended action: Apply the patch for #4131 and close.
- Patch: [bugs-4131.patch](../../patches/bugs-4131.patch), commit [`695ce6c16`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/695ce6c16dc4935da000dc61b74c23eff8c04764). Apply after `bugs-4157-1.patch`, `bugs-3121.patch`, `bugs-3847.patch`, `bugs-3849.patch`.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The assignment of the description, `*room_new = room ? *room : *RoomGet ();`, and the reduced form
`result = p ? *p : *f ();` of the second comment give wrong bytes on r17193 for mcs51, stm8, and
z80. The ticket reports wrong bytes for the third operand. On r17193 the bytes are wrong for
either value of the condition.

`support/regression/tests/bug-3857.c` has 8 assertions on these two statements and 8 on the two
forms that the fifth comment reports as correct. On r17193 the first 8 fail for mcs51-small,
mcs51-small-stack-auto, mcs51-large-stack-auto, stm8, and ucz80, and 6 of them fail for
mcs51-large. The other 8 pass.

## Cause

The cause is the one of #4163. `geniCodeConditional` in `src/SDCCicode.c` evaluates the second and
the third operand as values. An operand `*p` or `*f ()` of struct type is read through its address
as a scalar, and the bytes that were read are used as the address of the value. The intermediate
code in the third comment shows this read after the call.

## Fix

With the patch for #4131, `geniCodeConditional` evaluates both operands in the way the operand of
`&` is evaluated. The patch for #4054 removes the read of a struct from `geniCodeDerefPtr`. Each of
the two patches corrects the statements of this ticket without the other.

## Verification

With the patch for #4131 and without the patch for #4054, `bug-3857.c` passes on the host, for the
six mcs51 variants, for stm8, and for ucz80.

With the patch for #4054 and without the patch for #4131, the test passes for mcs51-small,
mcs51-large, mcs51-small-stack-auto, mcs51-large-stack-auto, stm8, and ucz80. The host,
mcs51-medium, and mcs51-huge were not run with this combination.

## Related

- #4131 has the patch.
- #4163 reports the same fault for an initializer.
- #4054 reports the read through the pointer for arguments of the form `*p`.
